abstract: The United Kingdom Children's Cancer Study Group (UKCCSG) malignant germ cell tumour (MGCT) studies were undertaken to establish standard protocols of investigation, staging, and treatment. The efficacy of new drug combinations and the value of serial measurements of serum alphafetoprotein (AFP) and human chorionic gonadotrophin (HCG) were evaluated. Following the initial surgery, staging of the tumour was performed using a variety of investigative approaches. In stage 1 testicular tumours, orchidectomy was performed. In more advanced tumours, and in stage 1 tumours that failed to show the expected decline in AFP or recurred, chemotherapy was used after appropriate surgery. Seventy-three boys, under 14 years of age, with testicular MGCTs have been entered into the UKCCSG studies since 1979. Serum AFP was measured preoperatively, or within 2 weeks of operation, in 70 boys. It was unequivocally elevated in 69. Monitoring by serial AFP measurement proved valuable in assessing response and in early detection of recurrence. HCG was measured in 46 boys, and was raised in three. Sixty-seven (91%) of the tumours were yolk sac (Teilum) tumours, four were immature teratoma, and two were mixed MGCTs. The only non-AFP producing tumour was an immature polydermal teratoma in a 1-year-old boy. Serum HCG was raised in three boys with yolk sac tumours, one with a mixed teratoma, and one 14-year-old boy who had a mixed MGCT. The results of treatment were assessed on April 1, 1989 (median time from diagnosis, 3 years 4 months). Seventy-one boys were alive, 48 of whom had been cured by orchidectomy alone. The remaining 25 patients received chemotherapy.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 英国小児がん研究グループ(UKCCSG)の悪性胚細胞腫瘍(MGCT)研究は、標準的な検査手順、病期分類、治療の確立を目的として実施された。新しい薬剤併用の有効性と、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の連続測定の意義を評価した。初回手術後、さまざまな検査法を用いて腫瘍の病期分類を行った。病期1の精巣腫瘍では精巣摘除術を施行した。進行した腫瘍、および病期1でありながらAFPの期待される低下が見られない、または再発した腫瘍では、適切な手術の後に化学療法を用いた。1979年以降、14歳未満の精巣MGCTを有する男児73例がUKCCSG研究に登録された。70例の男児では、術前または手術後2週間以内に血清AFPを測定した。69例で明らかな上昇が認められた。hCGは46例の男児で測定され、3例で上昇していた。腫瘍の67例(91%)は卵黄嚢(Teilum)腫瘍であり、4例は未熟奇形腫、2例は混合性MGCTであった。AFPを産生しなかった唯一の腫瘍は、1歳男児の未熟多皮性奇形腫であった。血清hCGは卵黄嚢腫瘍の男児3例、混合奇形腫の男児1例、混合MGCTの14歳男児1例で上昇していた。治療成績は1989年4月1日時点で評価された(診断からの中央値3年4か月)。71例の男児が生存しており、そのうち48例は精巣摘除術のみで治癒していた。残りの25例は化学療法を受けた。(抄録は250語で打ち切られている)
